callcard — merge the two views of a callable

From sigs.tsv ⋈ resolved.tsv (+ docs.tsv) by scripts/build_callcard.nu: the parser supplies the name and as-written signature; reflection supplies the resolved types. Joined on path, they're one full card per function — the semantic depth comes from combining, not from guessing.
